lines.zh: 我飘过雪地，没留下脚印。
lines.en: I drift over the snow without leaving any prints.

lines.zh: 袍角拖过冰面，发出细响。
lines.en: My hem drags on the ice with a thin hiss.

lines.zh: 塔里的台阶我早已不用走。
lines.en: I no longer bother with the tower stairs.

lines.zh: 我一晃，就出现在三步外。
lines.en: One flicker and I am three steps away.

lines.zh: 骨头在袍子里互相磕碰。
lines.en: My bones knock together under the robe.

lines.zh: 我沿着塔的螺旋往上飘。
lines.en: I float up along the tower's spiral.

lines.zh: 冷风穿过我，我不觉得冷。
lines.en: The cold wind passes through me; I feel nothing.

lines.zh: 我的影子在雪上淡得看不清。
lines.en: My shadow on the snow is barely visible.

lines.zh: 我越过冰裂缝，脚不沾地。
lines.en: I cross the crevasse without touching the ground.

lines.zh: 这具身体走路总要费点力。
lines.en: Walking in this body takes some effort.
I sit atop the tower and watch the snow fall.

lines.zh: 灵魂之星还在我手里转。
lines.en: The soul star still turns in my hand.
I silently count how many years remain.
My bones have been still too long and feel stiff.

lines.zh: 塔下的风声像有人在哭。
lines.en: The wind below the tower sounds like weeping.
I lay my staff across my knees.
The living always love to climb high places.

lines.zh: 我记得这座塔的每一块砖。
lines.en: I know every brick of this tower.

lines.zh: 火盆里的蓝焰跳了一下。
lines.en: The blue flame in the brazier jumps once.
My breathing is only an imitation.
Cold is merely a habit to me.

lines.zh: 我在等一个够格的挑战者。
lines.en: I am waiting for a worthy challenger.

lines.zh: 袍子上的霜又厚了一层。
lines.en: The frost on my robe has thickened again.
The quiet makes me think of many old things.
Frost creeps in through the window crack, slow.

lines.zh: 我数塔里的台阶，十七级。
lines.en: I count the tower stairs: seventeen.
The blue flame warms nothing in this room.

lines.zh: 我的王座是用骨头垒的。
lines.en: My throne is stacked from old bones.

lines.zh: 你顺着灵魂之星找来了。
lines.en: You followed the soul star all the way here.

lines.zh: 我低头看你，眼里没有温度。
lines.en: I look down at you with eyes that hold no warmth.
Another one come to take the loot.

lines.zh: 灵魂之星把你带进我的塔。
lines.en: The soul star led you into my tower.

lines.zh: 我认得这种眼神，是贪婪。
lines.en: I know that look; it is greed.
You climbed this tower; not bad.
There is no face beneath my hood.
Stare too long and you will have nightmares.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸在雪里成了白雾。
lines.en: Your breath turns to white mist in the snow.

lines.zh: 我记得你身后的每一具尸体。
lines.en: I remember every corpse behind you.

lines.zh: 别急着动手，先看看四周。
lines.en: Do not rush to strike; look around first.

lines.zh: 你比上一个撑得久些吧？
lines.en: Will you last longer than the last one?
My robe is torn.
One bone is cracked, which hardly matters.
You hit me? Some skill after all.
Pain is a living sensation.
My form wavers for a moment.
That blow reminds me of dying.
I slip into the shadows to regroup.

lines.zh: 我的灵魂之星暗了一瞬。
lines.en: My soul star dims for an instant.
You have broken my incantation.
The bones will grow back on their own.
Gold? I buried a whole room of it long ago.
You hold food up high; how absurd.
I do not eat food; I eat time.
Take it away; the smell wearies me.
I have no use for offerings from the living.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西换不来饶命。
lines.en: What you hold will not buy you mercy.

lines.zh: 我年轻时也馋过，早忘了。
lines.en: I hungered once, long ago; I have forgotten.
Stop waving it; put it in your pack.

lines.zh: 我只要你身上的那点热气。
lines.en: I want only the warmth inside your body.
Tempting the dead is wasted effort.

lines.zh: 你穿过我的袍子，打了个寒战。
lines.en: You brush through my robe and shiver.
I hardly weigh anything at all.

lines.zh: 你一撞，我散成一片冷雾。
lines.en: You bump me and I scatter into cold mist.
Do not touch me; living hands are too hot.

lines.zh: 我重新聚拢，位置变了一点。
lines.en: I re-form, shifted a little to one side.

lines.zh: 塔里的灵魂之星又亮了一颗。
lines.en: Another soul star lights up in my tower.

lines.zh: 你退开时，脚印比来时深。
lines.en: Your prints are deeper going back than coming.

lines.zh: 我的袍角扫过你的靴子。
lines.en: My hem sweeps across your boots.

lines.zh: 撞我一下，你就老了一岁。
lines.en: One bump and you age a year.
Keeping your distance suits us both.

lines.zh: 我的新娘在很久以前就腐了。
lines.en: My bride rotted away a very long time ago.
The dead have no need of pairs.

lines.zh: 你想问繁殖？先活过我再说。
lines.en: Breeding? Outlive me first.
My bloodline ended at the base of this tower.
Love is an illness of the living.

lines.zh: 我抱着法杖，比抱谁都快活。
lines.en: I hold my staff happier than any hand.

lines.zh: 塔里只有我和我的影子。
lines.en: Only my shadow and I live in this tower.

lines.zh: 别再提那些温热的字眼。
lines.en: Do not speak those warm words again.

lines.zh: 我早把心留在了棺材里。
lines.en: I left my heart in the coffin long ago.
Long solitude has become a habit.

lines.zh: 我不用手捡，东西会自己飘来。
lines.en: I do not pick things up; they float to me.
I once wore a ring like that one.
Loot? Save it for the next one.

lines.zh: 我抬手，物品就悬在半空。
lines.en: I lift a hand and the item hangs in midair.
I need to carry nothing while I drift.

lines.zh: 地上的东西大多属于死者。
lines.en: Most things on the ground belong to the dead.
Let it lie there; I do not bend.

lines.zh: 这枚骨头是我的旧部件。
lines.en: This bone was once part of me.
It is enough for me to burn it to ash.
Collecting things is a living creature's work.

lines.zh: 你踏进塔门，就归我管了。
lines.en: Step through my door and you are mine.

lines.zh: 灵魂之星指向的，从来是我。
lines.en: The soul star always pointed at me.
I raise my hand and the snow halts.

lines.zh: 你的名字，我已经记下了。
lines.en: I have already written down your name.

lines.zh: 这里每一具骨头都曾这样看我。
lines.en: Every bone here once looked at me like that.
Challenger, your timing is just right.

lines.zh: 我不急，我已经等了太久。
lines.en: I am in no hurry; I have waited far too long.
The tower door has closed behind you.

lines.zh: 你选的这条路，尽头是我。
lines.en: The path you chose ends at me.
I hear your boots trembling.
The only audience tonight is the snow.
Let me see whether you are worth it.
I raise my staff and blue flame kindles.

lines.zh: 生者总是自己走进塔里。
lines.en: The living always walk into the tower themselves.

lines.zh: 活人的热气，隔着门外就有。
lines.en: Living warmth reaches me through the door.
Come up; I am at the very top.

lines.zh: 楼梯尽头的光，是我点的。
lines.en: The light at the stair's end is mine.
You brought a sword. That is polite.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的胸口，那里最暖。
lines.en: I fix on your chest; that is the warmest part.

lines.zh: 你一动，我的法术就跟着。
lines.en: When you move, my magic follows.

lines.zh: 传送的门口已经在背后开了。
lines.en: A portal has opened behind you.

lines.zh: 别以为躲在柱子后就没用。
lines.en: Hiding behind a pillar will not save you.
I lift my hand and the air begins to frost.
The shadow behind you belongs to me now.
My barrage has not been released yet.

lines.zh: 你数得清我有几个分身吗？
lines.en: Can you count how many of me there are?
One more step and you are inside the circle.

lines.zh: 我的耐心和这座塔一样高。
lines.en: My patience is as tall as this tower.

lines.zh: 你护着左边，右边就空着。
lines.en: You guard the left, so the right hangs open.

lines.zh: 我看着你的手指扣紧剑柄。
lines.en: I watch your fingers tighten on the hilt.
This is the instant I have been waiting for.
Do not look back; I am behind you as well.
I have opened a door behind you.

lines.zh: 冰面上，你的脚步在打滑。
lines.en: Your feet are slipping on the ice.

lines.zh: 我抬手，三具骷髅站起来。
lines.en: I raise my hand; three skeletons rise.
My volley comes from four directions.

lines.zh: 盾放下之前，我的冰锥就到了。
lines.en: My ice spikes arrive before your shield drops.

lines.zh: 等你法力耗尽，我再靠近。
lines.en: When your power runs dry, I close in.
My staff falls, and ice spikes follow it.
One sweep and the barrage covers the whole floor.
Frozen in place, are you not?
I surface right beside you.
This blow carries a century of spite.

lines.zh: 小怪会替我把你围起来。
lines.en: My minions will close the circle for me.

lines.zh: 你挡得了法术，挡不了寒意。
lines.en: You can block spells, but not the chill.

lines.zh: 我打得不重，但你会冷到骨里。
lines.en: Not a heavy hit, but it chills you to the bone.
You retreat into the snow; just as I wished.

lines.zh: 我的骷髅手抓住了你的手腕。
lines.en: My skeletal hand seizes your wrist.
Blue flame grazes across your armor.
Do not counter yet; thaw out first.
I have practiced this move for three hundred years.
The way you gasp is almost funny.
The seal atop the tower has loosened.
I sit up out of the coffin.
Snow fell for three centuries, and I am awake.
The soul star has begun to turn again.
This tower has a master once more.

lines.zh: 有人推开了最上面那扇门。
lines.en: Someone has opened the topmost door.

lines.zh: 我的骨头一节节接回来。
lines.en: My bones knit back together, joint by joint.
The brazier lights itself with blue flame.
Frost spreads outward from beneath me.
Visitor, I have awaited you a long time.

lines.zh: 塔里的钟没有敲，却响了。
lines.en: The tower's bell rings without being struck.
I don the robe and straighten my hood.
The snow will not stop tonight.
Atop the high tower, there is only me.

lines.zh: 棺材板上的霜裂了一道缝。
lines.en: A crack splits the frost on my coffin lid.
The candle lights itself, blue.

lines.zh: 三具骷髅从地板下爬出。
lines.en: Three skeletons claw up through the floor.
Someone has touched my seal.
I watch you from the dark at the top.
The wind stops because I am awake.

lines.zh: 火焰舔过袍角，我皱了皱眉。
lines.en: Flame licks my hem and I frown.

lines.zh: 我从塔顶坠下，骨头散了一地。
lines.en: I fall from the tower and my bones scatter.

lines.zh: 冰水灌进胸腔，很奇怪的感觉。
lines.en: Icy water fills my ribcage; a strange feeling.
The blast blows my hood clean off.

lines.zh: 箭穿过我的肩膀，没带出血。
lines.en: An arrow passes through my shoulder without blood.

lines.zh: 圣光灼着我，我很不喜欢。
lines.en: Holy light sears me and I dislike it greatly.

lines.zh: 我早已不饿，只是力量在减。
lines.en: I am not hungry; my strength is simply fading.

lines.zh: 雷光穿透我，骨头都在响。
lines.en: Lightning passes through me and my bones ring.

lines.zh: 虚空之下，连死者也会坠。
lines.en: Beneath the void, even the dead can fall.
